description: Generate a complete song (vocals or instrumental) from a prompt and lyrics with MiniMax Music 3.0 or 2.6.
summary: Generate music — a complete song from a text prompt and lyrics — with MiniMax music-3.0 (the current recommended model) or music-2.6. Provide lyrics for a vocal track, or request an instrumental; lyrics can also be written automatically from the prompt. Each run produces one generated song.

model.description: Music model. music-3.0 is MiniMax's current recommended generation; music-2.6 is the previous one. Same $0.15 price per song.

prompt.description: Description of the music's style, mood, and scenario. Required when is_instrumental is true.

lyrics.description: Song lyrics, using \n to separate lines. Supports structure tags: [Intro], [Verse], [Pre Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro], [Solo], etc. Required unless is_instrumental or lyrics_optimizer is true.

is_instrumental.description: Generate instrumental music (no vocals). When true, prompt is required.

lyrics_optimizer.description: Auto-generate lyrics from the prompt when lyrics is empty.

output_format.description: Audio is always returned as a CDN URL (link EXPIRES after 24h). Fixed — no other value is accepted.

stream.description: Streaming is not supported; always false. Fixed.

notes: PER_UNIT_MATRIX by model — music-3.0 and music-2.6 both $0.15 per song (0% markup, pass-through).
The completed run returns the audio as a CDN URL (the link EXPIRES after 24h — download promptly).
